_comment: Config-driven agent/model registry for the GEAK standalone runtime. Two orthogonal axes: 'agents' (how to drive a code-agent CLI, model-independent) and 'models' (an endpoint, CLI-independent). A 'profile' pins one (agent, model) combo. Confirm each CLI with `<cli> --help` at bring-up. Override supported values through GEAK_<CLI>_* environment variables or a backends/<name>.mjs escape hatch.

qwen.note: Non-interactive auth needs ~/.qwen/settings.json {security.auth.selectedType:'openai'}; configure an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with OPENAI_API_KEY and OPENAI_BASE_URL.

codex.note: Codex Responses API backend. An explicit OPENAI_BASE_URL selects any operator-provided OpenAI-compatible endpoint; otherwise OPENAI_API_KEY selects the official OpenAI endpoint. GEAK_CODEX_EXTRA_ARGS remains the final override.

hermes.note: Hermes Agent runs the same unchanged GEAK workflow prompts. Select a dedicated Hermes profile with terminal/file tools and an empty fallback chain through GEAK_HERMES_PROFILE; select its inference provider explicitly through GEAK_HERMES_PROVIDER.

kimi.note: official kimi-cli (PyPI, install via uv --python 3.13). OpenAI-compatible via ~/.kimi/config.toml (type=openai_legacy, default_model). --quiet=print+final-only, --afk=unattended auto-approve. Needs SSL_CERT_FILE for gateway CA. prompt is the value of -p (last arg); model via config default_model (generic path omits -m to keep -p<prompt> adjacent).

cursor.note: AgentKernelArena-style cursor-agent CLI (--force --print). Auth uses cursor-agent login or CURSOR_API_KEY and runs on Cursor cloud. Verify output-format and model flags against `cursor-agent --help` at bring-up.

_models_comment: Public defaults only. Operators may supply any OpenAI-compatible endpoint with OPENAI_BASE_URL and its matching key environment.

openai_official.note: Set GEAK_CODEX_MODEL to a model available to your account over the Responses API.
